description: Turn Attack Mode on or off. Turn it on only after the person said yes to the quote's confirmation, with that quote_id and a unique idempotency_key you keep for retries. On while already on returns the current activation and charges nothing; a retry with the same idempotency_key returns the same activation. Exit is free.

business.description: The business to act on, by its domain (such as example.com), one of those list_businesses shows. Needed only when your accounts track more than one business.

name: set_attack_mode
title: Turn Attack Mode on or off
